Tag checks, some useful tips last week
We write to travelers
Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers need to know that pet journeys must be prepared with care before check-in and boarding.

Our desk manages each case from booking through pickup, with safety placed ahead of speed at every step. Please bring the required documents, keep carriers secure, and follow the welcome team's directions without delay. <<FACT F004>> Travelers with nervous animals should allow extra room for calm handling, clean bedding, and a brief health check before movement.

We also coordinate care in line with species, temperament, and comfort needs, so every pet receives the right support through the journey. <<FACT F011>> Keep food, water, and any approved items ready, and make sure labels are clear on all carriers and bags. If you are traveling with a pet such as Thor, follow the desk guidance closely and stay with your animal until staff advise otherwise.

For any further help, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
